job.rawJd:
MERGE is a marketing and technology agency purpose-built for health and wellness. The VP, Account Management - Pharma / Life Science role is both a team and business leadership position and a trusted strategic-advisor role for high-impact healthcare accounts.

What You'll Do:
- Act as the primary advocate and trusted expert for pharma and biotech clients, partnering with executive and C-suite leaders to connect marketing initiatives to business goals.
- Direct a $5-7M book of business, deliver on revenue forecasts, and identify incremental growth opportunities.
- Oversee complex marketing programs, digital experiences, paid media, and multichannel strategy across HCP and DTC audiences.
- Lead, delegate to, and mentor cross-functional agency teams while building a positive culture.
- Establish short- and long-term account and brand roadmaps.

What You'll Bring:
- 8-10+ years of agency account-management experience with deep pharmaceutical marketing specialization.
- A track record leading integrated campaigns for both HCP and patient or consumer audiences.
- Success managing agency accounts of $5M or more and leading cross-functional teams.
- High-trust relationships with executive-level client stakeholders.
- A record of meeting or exceeding revenue forecasts and expanding accounts.
- Strong team management and talent-development skills.

Bonus:
- Experience in CNS drug categories, including neurology, psychiatry, or neurodegenerative conditions.

paragraphs: I am applying for the VP, Account Management - Pharma / Life Science role at MERGE. I spent eight years managing pharmaceutical agency accounts, with responsibility for client relationships, large consumer businesses, multichannel campaigns, regulated review, strategic recommendations, and team delivery. Since then, I have led enterprise UX teams, advised executives, and built workflow tools for pharmaceutical agencies. That combination gives me a broader operating view than I had earlier in my account career.

At FCB Health, I was one of two consumer account leads on the agency's largest pharmaceutical business and managed the $20M Namenda XR direct-to-consumer launch. I led the broadcast workstream for three national commercials in one year, from market research and med-legal review through FDA preclearance, production, and network clearance. The spots drove a 45% increase in new-to-brand consumers within seven weeks. Earlier, on the $10M NUVIGIL consumer business, I owned weekly client status and financial reporting, OPDP submissions, multichannel delivery, and annual strategic recommendations. I also worked alongside the HCP team on the NUVIGIL site and sales aid.

CNS work has been a consistent part of my pharmaceutical background. It includes Namenda XR in Alzheimer's disease, XYREM in narcolepsy, NUVIGIL in sleep and wakefulness, and Zoloft in psychiatry. At Scout Marketing, I was promoted to Account Supervisor / Digital Strategist and led XYREM consumer work across digital, print, social, and in-office channels. The work included Jazz's first unbranded social campaign and a digital program that doubled qualified traffic to the brand site.

The work that followed added the leadership range I would bring back to account management. At Heartbeat Ideas, I turned research into patient, HCP, and brand-team experiences. At Kinesso, I grew a distributed design team from 2 to 30, led analytics work used by more than 7,000 people across 22 brands, and partnered with C-suite stakeholders on monetization and go-to-market planning. Today, I build pharmaceutical agency tools for claim review, brief intake, scoping, review routing, and MLR preparation.

My record is strongest in DTC account leadership, large-budget stewardship, and cross-functional delivery. Setting commercial forecasts and carrying measured expansion targets would be a step up in scope, not something I would claim from my earlier roles. I am interested in MERGE because the role connects that responsibility with the pharmaceutical, CNS, team-leadership, and technology experience I already bring. I would welcome the chance to discuss the fit.

resume.summary: Pharmaceutical account leader with eight years in agencies, progressing from Account Coordinator to Account Supervisor. I led Fortune 500 client relationships, CNS brands, DTC and multichannel programs, a $20M launch, and weekly reporting across a $10M consumer business. Since then, I have grown a team from 2 to 30, partnered with C-suite stakeholders, and built pharma workflow tools, bringing broader team, HCP, analytics, and product experience back to account leadership.
